query: INSERT INTO sync_request_resource (org_id, request_id, ordinal, locator, state, failure_detail) SELECT $1, $2, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(ordinal) FROM sync_request_resource WHERE org_id = $1 AND request_id = $2), -1) + 1, $3, 'failed', $4 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_request_resource WHERE org_id = $1 AND request_id = $2 AND locator = $3)
